author: Yuchen Li
scope_warning: This 196-bit block-quota QUBO is a restricted feasible subset of the global-budget problem, not an exact full global-budget QUBO; no physical solve or acceptance is implied.
matrix_format: Headerless square upper-triangular signed-int8 CSV; E = x.T @ Q @ x

baseline.construction: For each two-layer block, upgrade every tensor in the first layer and keep the second layer at the base type.

formulation.raw_block_qubo: -sum_i((gain_i - center_b)*x_i) + penalty_b*(sum_i(x_i)-quota_b)^2; one block per shape group and two transformer layers
formulation.gain_definition: measured lower-type squared-weight-error minus measured upper-type squared-weight-error
formulation.gain_center_rule: midpoint of the minimum and maximum measured gains in the block
formulation.penalty_rule: max_i abs(gain_i-center_b)+1, floored at twice the initial global int8 scale
formulation.interpretation: Proxy objective matches the original only within each fixed-quota block; quota constraints remove cross-block byte trades.

unrestricted_two_choice_optimum.method: exact count enumeration of the two-choice global-budget MILP
